# Ruben Marcus: Senior AI Fullstack Engineer

> Personal site of Ruben Marcus, a senior AI fullstack engineer based in Lisbon
> (remote worldwide). 13 years across AI tooling, Web3, fintech, and e-commerce.
> Builds autonomous AI agent systems, evaluation harnesses, AEO tooling, and
> premium web experiences. Available for full-time roles and freelance contracts.

## Main sections

- [Index](https://rubenmarcus.dev/): Hero, services (hire me for), proof-in-numbers stats, open-source tools, selected work.
- [Portfolio](https://rubenmarcus.dev/portfolio): Filterable 14-year project archive. Filter by era/company and technology.
- [AI](https://rubenmarcus.dev/ai): AI expertise (agent orchestration, evaluation design, AEO, production LLM features) and the open-source tools that prove it.
- [Agents](https://rubenmarcus.dev/agents): The autonomous agent fleet behind this site and client work — roles, orchestration model, and what each agent ships.
- [Blog](https://rubenmarcus.dev/blog): Technical articles on agents, benchmarks, WebGL, and the stack.
- [About](https://rubenmarcus.dev/about): Bio, timeline, contact details.
- [Contact](https://rubenmarcus.dev/contact): Project inquiries for AI tooling, agents, AEO, Web3.

## Open-source tools

- [Ralph Starter](https://ralphstarter.ai): AI coding orchestration platform. Multi-agent swarms over isolated git worktrees, MCP server.
- [Autoresearcher](https://autoresearcher.org): Benchmark-driven autonomous research CLI. Multi-agent co-evolution with a Pareto frontier.
- [AEO.js](https://aeojs.org): Answer Engine Optimization framework. AI-crawler policy analysis, llms.txt and ai-index.json exports.
- [check.aeojs.org](https://check.aeojs.org): Free AEO scanner. 4,500+ sites scanned.

- CS Brasil (browser FPS): 2,191 players, 154K+ kills, 27 countries.
